invariants.rationale: It is often required that input collection arguments are non-null before proceeding to method logic.
config is dereferenced in the method body, so it should be non-null.
context is used as an argument, so it being non-null is required for safe execution.
table is passed as a parameter to another method, so it must not be null.
operationType is used as a parameter and should be non-null for correct operation.
